answer: An farming party running 61 aliases therefore needs 31 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in trellis, expire in walnut, and summit lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 16 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 2000 identities would post 4836 proofs and burn roughly 37 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
